root_causes.root_cause: clip_text_already_exported guard in _recover_picture_text skips PictureResult creation (no png_bytes, no ocr_text) for vector-drawn charts whose text labels are already in the Docling markdown export. Combined with VLM_DESCRIBE_IMAGES=false (default), no visual chart semantics (chart type, bar/pie relationships, axis context) are ever captured -- only the bare numeric labels survive as flat text.
root_causes.code_path: converters.py:_recover_picture_text -> clip_text guard (L1834-1852) skips crop+OCR when clip_text is contained in markdown; _recover_picture_results returns placeholder PictureResult(skipped_reason='clip_text_already_exported') with no png_bytes; _enrich_image_blocks finds nothing to persist; _add_vlm_descriptions skipped because vlm_describe_images=false
root_causes.suggested_fix: When a region is skipped with clip_text_already_exported, still retain the cropped png_bytes in the PictureResult so that (a) the figure PNG is persisted to MinIO for downstream consumers and (b) when VLM_DESCRIBE_IMAGES is enabled, the chart gets a semantic description. This decouples 'text already extracted' from 'visual context already captured'. Alternatively, add a chart-specific enrichment path that generates a structured chart description (chart type, axes, data series) from the crop even without full VLM.

needs_doc_drilldown.doc: image pie chart about labor distribution in january 2025 - Copy.jpg
needs_doc_drilldown.reason: JPG takes a different code path (standalone image route, lines 907-943 in client.py) that creates synthetic PictureResults with png_bytes but uses Docling OCR which produces garbled Arabic. The shared RC1 clip_text guard does not apply here since this is not a PDF going through _recover_picture_results. The symptom (garbled Arabic OCR, missing chart enrichment) has a different mechanism: (1) Docling image_to_markdown produces garbled Arabic OCR output, (2) VLM describe is off so no visual description, (3) content volume halved because RFC-027 D6 duplicate marker collapse removed duplicate fig-0/fig-1 blocks from Run 10. Needs separate investigation of Arabic OCR quality in the Docling image pipeline.
